role_reason: Slot Bang Ray hari ini membawa produk resmi PT Intan Suar Kartika yaitu Paku Cap Keris (SNI 0194-78) dengan pendekatan soft-selling. Cerita berfokus pada edukasi teknis memaku kayu balok keras agar tidak pecah, menonjolkan batang baja lurus paku tanpa hard-selling.
title: Trik Paku Kayu Balok Keras Biar Gak Pecah
hook: Banyak yang nanya ke Ray kenapa kalau kita maku kayu balok keras kayunya malah retak atau pakunya meliuk.
story: Bang Ray berdiri di meja kerja bengkel kayunya di Banda Aceh dengan kemeja navy dan celana kerja khaki. Di meja kerja kayu di samping balok kayu keras dan martil, terlihat terbuka kotak kardus cokelat Paku Cap Keris bertuliskan hijau tua. Bang Ray memegang satu paku baja, memperlihatkan ujungnya ke kamera, menjelaskan trik menumpulkan ujung paku sedikit dengan ketokan martil agar serat kayu terdorong bukan dibelah, lalu mengetoknya tegak lurus ke balok. Di akhir video ia tersenyum dan bertanya penonton punya trik apa saat memaku kayu keras.
caption:
Trik sederhana maku kayu balok keras biar gak pecah dan gak bikin kerja dua kali. Paku bajanya dari @intansuarkartika rakan. Rakan sendiri biasa pakai trik apa kalau ketemu kayu keras?
#tipsbangunan #pertukangan #tukangkayu #aceh #pakucapkeris #intansuarkartika

shots.prompt: Authentic handheld smartphone vlog video of Bang Ray, the exact same Indonesian man shown in all attached reference images: image one is the three-expression portrait for FACE IDENTITY (match face shape, nose, eyebrows, skin tone, apparent age 26, calm confident expression), image two is his full-body turnaround for OUTFIT (navy short-sleeve work shirt over white undershirt, khaki work pants, black field watch). Vertical 9:16, 15 seconds, medium shot waist-up at eye level with very slight handheld sway. Location: woodworking workshop in Banda Aceh, wooden workbench and tools in background. PROP CONTINUITY: A thick raw wood timber block, a steel claw hammer, and a brown kraft cardboard box printed with dark green typography PAKU EXPORT QUALITY CAP KERIS sitting on the workbench from 0.0s to the end. Bang Ray holds one steel nail in his left fingers and a hammer in his right hand. He speaks directly to the camera in natural Indonesian with a warm Banda Aceh accent: he demonstrates tapping the tip of the nail lightly with the hammer face, explains that blunting the point prevents wood fibers from splitting, and drives the straight steel nail firmly into the timber block in two clean strikes without bending. He looks into the camera with a confident smile and asks viewers what tricks they use on hard wood. Natural clean daylight, neutral white balance 5500K, true-to-life colors, realistic matte human skin with visible fine pores, no plastic shine, zero CGI, authentic non-AI documentary look. Clean frame: no on-screen text, no subtitles, no watermark, no logo.
shots.dialogue: Biar kayu balok gak retak kuncinya ujung paku tumpulkan sedikit pakai martil rakan. Satu lagi jangan pakai paku banci yang gampang meliuk pakai paku baja yang batangnya padat biar sekali getok langsung masuk. Rakan sendiri kalau maku kayu keras punya trik apa?
